source: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF), Department of Agricultural Extension — trifold "ដំណាំល្ហុង" (Papaya Cultivation), citing Training Module on Fruit Tree Production (2013) and a farmer's field experience from Kampong district, Preah Vihear province (2012)
text:
Papaya land should be located near a reliable water source and must drain well, since papaya roots are sensitive to standing water. The source recommends keeping some distance between papaya and other crops planted nearby.

Before planting, till and loosen the soil so roots can establish easily, and choose the start of the dry season as a good planting window, since this tends to give better fruit quality and lower disease pressure than planting in the wettest part of the rainy season.
